title: Payout Methods: Currencies, Countries and Cross-Currency Figures by Rail
content:
Payout Methods are recorded in USD on every rail: balances and amounts are kept in USD, and a method paid in another currency is paid at the rail's conversion rate. Which currencies a host may receive, and in which countries a rail is offered, depend on the rail.

## Rail comparison

| Rail | Payout currencies supported | Countries of the host's bank or receiver profile where offered | Cross-currency fee percentage | Highest cross-currency fee per transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH) | USD | United States (US) | 0.00% | USD 0.00 (no cap) |
| Fast Pay Debit Card | USD | United States (US) | 0.00% | USD 0.00 (no cap) |
| PayPal | USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN | United States (US), Canada (CA), United Kingdom (GB), Mexico (MX) | 2.00% | USD 20.00 |
| Payoneer | USD, EUR, GBP | United States (US), United Kingdom (GB), Mexico (MX) | 2.00% | USD 0.00 (no cap) |
| International Wire Transfer | CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD | Canada (CA), United Kingdom (GB), Mexico (MX) | 0.00% | USD 0.00 (no cap) |
| Western Union Cash Pickup | MXN, USD | Mexico (MX) | 0.00% | USD 0.00 (no cap) |

## Definitions used in the table

- **Cross-currency fee percentage**: a decimal percent of the transfer, charged when the method's payout currency is not USD.
- **Highest cross-currency fee per transfer**: the ceiling on that fee for one transfer. On this column a figure of USD 0.00 means **no cap**; PayPal is the only rail with a ceiling, at USD 20.00.
- **Conversion rate**: on every rail, a non-USD transfer is converted at the Roamhaven daily conversion rate on the transfer date.
- **Currency of record**: USD on every rail; balances and amounts on a payout method are recorded in USD.

## Points of reference

- A Payoneer method paid in EUR has a cross-currency fee percentage of 2.00% and no ceiling, because the Payoneer ceiling column reads USD 0.00.
- A PayPal method paid in GBP has a cross-currency fee percentage of 2.00% and a ceiling of USD 20.00.
- An International Wire Transfer method paid in MXN shows 0.00% in the cross-currency column, as does every rail other than PayPal and Payoneer.
- Direct Deposit (ACH) and Fast Pay Debit Card support USD only and are offered only where the host's bank is in the United States; Western Union Cash Pickup is offered only for a receiver profile in Mexico.

**Hypothetical illustration of the two columns (not a fee calculation).** For an imagined PayPal transfer of USD 1500.00 paid out in CAD, 2.00% of the transfer is USD 30.00 and the PayPal ceiling of USD 20.00 is the highest cross-currency figure for that one transfer; the same imagined transfer on Payoneer in EUR would show USD 30.00 against no ceiling.
